answer: Make fake scale pay at the top, not at entry. Give every identity a basalt anchor: a slow, non-transferable deposit that only long, clean work can season, and that stays tied to its first name. Attach an umber tag to each anchor's funding trail, so trails sharing one funder converge visibly even when names differ. Standing then requires a summit check: unrelated peers must confirm anchor and tag agree, and a mismatch freezes the whole trail. One real participant risks one anchor; copies sharing a trail split one standing, so adding copies raises total risk without adding usable standing.
